mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID, TENANT_ID, USER_ID, KIND, STATUS, INPUT_JSON, RESULT_JSON, ERROR_TEXT, WEBHOOK_URL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, FINISHED_AT, LEASE_OWNER_ID, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT, LEASE_EPOCH FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (1=0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASYNC_TASK (TASK_ID, TENANT_ID, USER_ID, KIND, STATUS, INPUT_JSON, RESULT_JSON, ERROR_TEXT, WEBHOOK_URL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, FINISHED_AT, LEASE_OWNER_ID, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT, LEASE_EPOCH) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, #{resultJson}, #{errorText}, #{webhookUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{leaseOwnerId}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{leaseEpoch})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TASK_ID=#{taskId})
SELECT * FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT * FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND USER_ID=#{userId}) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (STATUS=#{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ASYNC_TASK SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND (FINISHED_AT IS NOT NULL AND FINISHED_AT < #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TASK_ID=#{taskId}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ASYNC_TASK SET STATUS=#{status}, RESULT_JSON=#{resultJson}, ERROR_TEXT=#{errorText}, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt}, FINISHED_AT=#{finishedAt}, LEASE_OWNER_ID=#{leaseOwnerId}, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT=#{leaseExpiresAt}, LEASE_EPOCH=#{leaseEpoch} WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TASK_ID=#{taskId})
UPDATE ASYNC_TASK_DISPATCH SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND TASK_ID IN (SELECT TASK_ID FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=1 AND FINISHED_AT IS NOT NULL AND FINISHED_AT < #{cutoff})
UPDATE ASYNC_TASK_DAG_CHECKPOINT SET DELETED=1 WHERE DELETED=0 AND TASK_ID IN (SELECT TASK_ID FROM ASYNC_TASK WHERE DELETED=1 AND FINISHED_AT IS NOT NULL AND FINISHED_AT < #{cutoff})
